843: function answerQuestion(text) {
844:   const query = text.toLowerCase()
845:   if (/(hint|stuck|help|lost)/.test(query)) {
846:     giveHint()
847:     return
848:   }
849:   if (/(scan|look around|search)/.test(query)) {
850:     scan()
851:     return
852:   }
853:   if (/(status|progress|objective|what now|what next)/.test(query)) {
854:     showStatus()
855:     return
856:   }
857:   if (/(who|name|pip|are you)/.test(query)) {
858:     assistant.push('PIP. Personal Interface Pilot, ECHO-7. I run the local systems, the door, and the commentary. Mostly the commentary.')
859:     return
860:   }
861:   if (/(hello|hi|hey|yo)\b/.test(query)) {
862:     assistant.push(hintPhase() === 'exit' ? 'Hello. Door is open. Go.' : 'Eyes up. Airlock is still sealed. What do you need?')
863:     return
864:   }
865:   if (/(fuse|power|relay|breaker|drawer)/.test(query)) {
866:     if (!state.power) {
867:       assistant.push(state.hasFuse
868:         ? 'You have the fuse. The auxiliary relay is the cabinet on your left wall. Insert it there.'
869:         : state.drawerOpen
870:           ? 'The fuse is in the open console drawer on your right. Click it, then take it to the relay on the left wall.'
871:           : 'Open the console drawer on your right. There should be a fuse inside — the relay on the left wall needs it.')
872:     } else {
873:       assistant.push('Power is online. Save the victory lap for after the airlock.')
874:     }
875:     return
876:   }
877:   if (/(star|constellation|projector|plaque|sequence|order)/.test(query)) {
878:     if (!state.power) assistant.push('Projector needs auxiliary power. Relay cabinet, left wall.')
879:     else if (state.codeKnown) assistant.push(`Already decoded. The sequence was Red Giant, Castor, Pollux, The Eye. Code: ${LAUNCH_CODE.split('').join('-')}.`)
880:     else if (!state.clueSeen) assistant.push('The order is on the crew plaque beside the airlock. Read it, then use the star projector on the right wall.')
881:     else assistant.push('Plaque order: Red Giant, the Twins — Castor and Pollux — then The Eye. Click those four stars on the projector in that order.')
882:     return
883:   }

885:     assistant.push(state.codeKnown
886:       ? `Launch code is ${LAUNCH_CODE.split('').join('-')}. Keypad is on the console.`
887:       : 'I do not have it yet. The NAV-7 projector on the right wall decrypts it once the star sequence is verified.')
888:     return

890:   if (/(door|airlock|escape|exit|leave|out)/.test(query)) {
891:     if (state.doorOpen) assistant.push('Door is open. Click the airlock. I will handle the paperwork.')
892:     else if (!state.power) assistant.push('Airlock is sealed and unpowered. Fuse first, then the relay.')
893:     else if (!state.codeKnown) assistant.push('Airlock needs a launch code. The star projector decrypts it. The plaque gives the order.')
894:     else assistant.push(`Enter ${LAUNCH_CODE.split('').join('-')} on the launch keypad, then click the airlock.`)
895:     return

898:     assistant.push('That was your pod. You have been out for a while. O2 is at eighteen percent, so no naps.')
899:     return

902:     assistant.push('Save it for after the airlock.')

buildEngineeringProps() {
    const group = new THREE.Group()
    group.position.set(0, 0, 2.88)
    group.visible = false
    this.scene.add(group)
    this.engineeringGroup = group

    const base = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.7, 0.82, 0.24, 28), this.mats.trimDark)
    base.position.y = 0.12
    group.add(base)
    this.disposables.push(base.geometry)

    const collar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.6, 0.05, 8, 40), this.mats.trimLight)
    collar.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2
    collar.position.y = 0.32
    group.add(collar)
    this.disposables.push(collar.geometry)

    this.reactorCoreMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x321407,
      emissive: 0xff7a2a,
      emissiveIntensity: 1.8,
      metalness: 0.5,
      roughness: 0.3,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.94
    })
    const core = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.3, 0.48, 1.55, 24), this.reactorCoreMat)
    core.position.y = 1.08
    group.add(core)
    this.disposables.push(core.geometry)

    const cap = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.24, 0.34, 0.22, 20), this.mats.trim)
    cap.position.y = 1.96
    group.add(cap)
    this.disposables.push(cap.geometry)

    this.reactorRings = []
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
      const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.5 + i * 0.12, 0.022, 6, 40), this.mats.amber)
      ring.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2
      ring.position.y = 0.55 + i * 0.5
      group.add(ring)
      this.disposables.push(ring.geometry)
      this.reactorRings.push(ring)
    }

    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const pipe = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.07, 0.07, 1.6, 12), this.mats.trim)
      pipe.position.set(side * 0.68, 0.8, -0.12)
      group.add(pipe)
      this.disposables.push(pipe.geometry)
      const elbow = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.16, 0.07, 8, 20, Math.PI / 2), this.mats.trim)
      elbow.position.set(side * 0.68, 1.6, -0.12)
      elbow.rotation.z = side > 0 ? Math.PI : -Math.PI / 2
      group.add(elbow)
      this.disposables.push(elbow.geometry)
    }

    this.reactorGlow = this.addGlow([0, 1.35, 2.9], 2.6, 0xff8a3d, 0.2)
    this.registerHotspot('reactor', [...group.children], group)
    this.contactShadow(0, 2.88, 1.8, 1.5, 0.5)
  }

    const rim = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.82, 0.035, 8, 48), this.mats.trimLight)

setPower(on) {
    this.powerOn = on
    this.powerStartedAt = performance.now()
    if (on) {
      this.statusScreen.refresh({ powered: true, codeKnown: this.codeKnown, unlocked: this.doorOpen })
      this.mapScreen.refresh({ powered: true, solved: this.codeKnown })
      this.relayIndicator.material.color.setHex(0x082016)
      this.relayIndicator.material.emissive.setHex(0x5dffb0)
      this.socketGlow.material.color.setHex(0x2bd8ff)
    }
  }

  setDoorLabel(text) {
    if (!this.doorLabelMat) return
    const previous = this.doorLabelMat.map
    this.doorLabelMat.map = this.textures.label(text, { width: 512, height: 96, size: 30 })
    this.doorLabelMat.needsUpdate = true
    previous?.dispose?.()
  }

  setDeck(index = 0) {
    const theme = THEMES[index] || THEMES[0]
    this.deck = index
    this.theme = theme
    this.scene.background = new THREE.Color(theme.bg)
    this.scene.fog.color.setHex(theme.fog)
    this.scene.fog.density = index === 1 ? 0.02 : index === 2 ? 0.019 : 0.016

    this.lights.forEach((entry, lightIndex) => {
      entry.onColor.setHex(theme.lights[lightIndex % theme.lights.length])
    })

    this.powerOn = index > 0
    this.powerStartedAt = performance.now()
    this.powerMix = index > 0 ? 1 : 0
    this.codeKnown = false
    this.doorOpen = false
    this.doorMix = 0
    this.doorSlab.position.y = 1.47
    this.doorGlowMat.opacity = 0
    this.doorHalo.material.opacity = 0.04
    this.doorRingMat.emissive.setHex(theme.door)
    this.doorStatus.material.emissive.setHex(theme.door)
    this.drawerOpen = false
    this.drawerMix = 0
    this.drawer.position.z = 0.39
    this.fuseObject.visible = false
    this.fuseObject.position.z = 0.55
    this.fuseGlow.visible = false
    this.fuseGlow.material.opacity = 0
    this.engineeringGroup.visible = index === 1
    this.bridgeGroup.visible = index === 2
    this.projectorMat.emissive.setHex(theme.accent)
    this.projectorRingMat.emissive.setHex(theme.accent)
    this.setDoorLabel(index === 0 ? 'AIRLOCK 01' : index === 1 ? 'DECK 02 HATCH' : 'LAUNCH HELM')
    this.statusScreen.refresh({ powered: index > 0, codeKnown: false, unlocked: false })
    this.mapScreen.refresh({ powered: index > 0, solved: false })
    if (index > 0) {
      this.relayIndicator.material.color.setHex(0x082016)
      this.relayIndicator.material.emissive.setHex(0x5dffb0)
      this.socketGlow.material.color.setHex(theme.accent)
    }
    this.pulse()
  }

Additional issues: - `renderSequencePips()` has weird extra loop but harmless. - `scan(enhanced)` when scanning already true: if user clicks Deep Scan while normal scan active, returns and skill gems still deducted? In useSkill deep-scan calls scan(true) before deducting. If state.scanning true, scan returns early, but then skill still deducts at end because applied true. That's a minor bug. We should make scan return boolean and useSkill handle. Similarly `scan` called by button. Let's fix: `scan` returns false if already scanning; skill checks result. Currently `useSkill` applies true always. We can update scan to return true/false and in deep-scan/hull-whisper set applied = scan(true). But then if false, we shouldn't deduct; show message maybe. Better change. - In `useSkill`, effect may call `scan(true)` which uses audio and assistant; then at end deduct. If false, applied=false and no deduct. Good. - Overdrive: if used then user enters deck?? state.boosts persists. Fine. - `door-sense` sets doorSenseUntil but syncMarkers does not use it! We forgot to incorporate. The skill claims tag exit but syncMarkers ignores `doorSenseUntil`. Need add attention to door in each deck: `attention: ... || Date.now() < state.doorSenseUntil`. Add helper `doorSenseActive()`. Also perhaps set a timer to refresh markers after 30s so class clears. Currently no refresh after timeout. Add `setTimeout(refreshUi, 30000)` or use `window.setTimeout(syncMarkers, 30100)`. We'll add in useSkill door-sense. Also sync markers attention for door. Since syncMarkers called immediately, marker attention class. After 30s call syncMarkers. Good. - Similarly scan enhanced marker state handled by room.setScanning (CSS scanning) not marker attention. Fine. - `state.scanUntil` unused; okay could remove but harmless. - `doorSenseUntil` now used. - `hull-whisper` uses scan(true), good. - `star-sight` if used on deck0 after code solved no spend; good. If used before code on deck0 sets boost, but when player then opens constellation, auto selects first star. Fine. - `vector-lock` on deck0 could be used; fine. On deck2 prefill. Good. - `warp-core` use triggers finishGame and then deducts gems afterward; finishGame completes final task and updates ending gems as gemsEarned not current. It calls `completeTask` which refreshUi and updates; then after effect returns, deduct 12, refreshUi. Fine. But ending displayed after 950ms; gems earned unaffected. No problem. Maybe warp core should be spend before finish? It's fine. - `completeTask` for final task after warp/launch: legend skill unlock. At ending, 9/9. Good. - `finishGame` calls `completeTask('bridge',2,{quiet:true})` then updates ending. If invoked via warp core, `finishGame` is on timeout 500ms after useSkill deducts. fine. - `useSkill('legend')` assistant only. fine. - `state.transitioning` set in showDeckClear; enterDeck sets false. When final finishGame, not set but won blocks. - At deck2→deck3 transition, `showDeckClear(1)` sets `state.transitioning=true`, room active false. EnterDeck sets false. Good. - At deck1→deck2, `completeTask('cryo',2,{quiet:true})` happens only at door. In showDeckClear deck index 0. Good. - Potential bug: In `completeTask`, `refreshUi` calls `renderLoadout`; if loadout collapsed on mobile it stays collapsed. On task complete, `setLoadoutOpen(true)` only if not quiet. Good. - On deck clear overlay, skill panel behind is not updated? It was updated by quiet task; yes. - `updateObjectives` active logic uses `done.slice(0,index).every(Boolean)` meaning if first task undone but second done, second never active. But actual tasks can be done out of order. If breaker done before cutter, cutter remains active, fine. If first done, second done, third active. If second done but first not, second is done (with line through) and first active. Fine. - In deck1, cutter task and breaker task can be done out of order; task completion order not enforced. Fine. - Objective progress count works. - Bridge keypad enforces nav solved. Good. - Bridge can enter keypad only after nav; correct. - The `keypadLocked` reset when close? When open, set false. Fine. - On keypad error, `state.keypadLocked` true then resets after 900. Good. - On `openKeypad` if `state.boosts.digits`, prefill. Good. - Surge on keypad with wrong code: we set status and reset after 900; no `keypadLocked` false until timeout, okay. - Surge on star wrong: sequence preserved, but the wrong star remains `.wrong` for 750ms then removed. Good. - If surge active and star solved later, boost consumed. fine. - In `openConstellation`, if solved it sets `state.sequence=[...activeSequence()]`; then `syncStarSelection`. Good. - But if the player partially selected stars and closes modal then reopens, `state.sequence` still partial and `updateStarLine` shows line; good. - On deck3, `updateConstellationClue` calls before `refs` maybe exist; yes. - `clue-label` dynamic fix. - Scene `setDeck` called only enterDeck; initial deck 0 default but theme etc set. Good. - Scene setDeck resets `this.doorOpen=false`, `this.drawerOpen=false`, `this.fuseObject.visible=false`; and also resets `this.codeKnown=false`; good. - Scene `setDeck` does not reset `this.drawerOpenedAt` but drawerOpen false means drawerMix=0. Fine. - Scene `setDeck` does not reset `this.doorOpenedAt`; doorOpen false, doorMix 0. Fine. - Scene setDeck `this.projectorMat.emissive.setHex(theme.accent)` but animate doesn't change emissive color, only intensity. For bridge purple accent, good. For engineering amber. For cryo cyan. Nice. - Scene `this.projectorRingMat.emissive` similarly. - `this.doorRingMat.emissive` animate resets to theme.door. Good. - `this.doorStatus` status animate uses theme.door. Good. - `this.stripMat` theme. - `statusScreen`/`mapScreen` call `refresh` in animate with powered p>0.5. For deck1/2 p=1. Good. - Engineering reactor group and bridge group at same location; toggled. - New markers 'reactor' and 'navtable' positions at [0,1.62,2.88]. The actual group at z=2.88, core center y ~1, marker y1.62. Fine. - Engineering reactor might be behind camera initially at z=2.88 (positive z). Since camera looks -z initially, not visible until turn around. That's fine; 360 room. - Scene setDoorLabel uses `this.textures.label` and disposes previous map. But textures.label might use cache? Need inspect label function to ensure new texture; probably. Fine. - Scene `this.scene.background = new THREE.Color(theme.bg)` each setDeck; fine. - Potential bug: `THEMES` lights array has 7 entries; `this.lights` has 7. Good. - CSS `.breaker-info .keypad-wide` flex. Fix. - CSS deck clear card title "CRYO BAY ESCAPED" good. - CSS `.ending-stats` 4 columns; screenshot shows 4. Good. - Mobile ending stats 2 cols. - Mobile: `setLoadoutOpen(false)` on init after `renderLoadout`. `renderLoadout` doesn't change collapsed. good. `loadout-toggle` click sets open if collapsed; `setLoadoutOpen(refs.pipLoadout.classList.contains('collapsed'))`: if collapsed true -> open true. Good. - But after task complete on mobile, `setLoadoutOpen(true)` expands, maybe shrinks chat; acceptable since it's an unlock moment. Could be annoying but okay. - Intro on mobile shows features; fine. - Accessibility: skill buttons disabled if not affordable; cannot click. Locked uses disabled. Tooltip. - Another issue: `showDeckClear` uses `refs.deckClearTitle.innerHTML = `${deck.name} ESCAPED``; deck names safe static. fine. - Missing "different levels of the ship unlocks as u escape each room" perhaps deck rail shows. Good. - "the co pilot unlocks skills and gems with every complete task" — completeTask grants gems and one skill each, shown. Good. - We should maybe mention "assumptions" at the end: added 3 decks, 9 tasks, 9 skills, 118 gems. Fix items now: 1. Add id `constellation-clue-label` and `projector-footer-label`? The footer labels are spans "PROJECTOR: "; we can leave. But clue label should dynamic. Add id to HTML and ref, update openConstellation. 2. Add `#constellation-foot-label` around "PROJECTOR:" maybe. Use id `projector-label`. Update to "ARRAY:" or "PROJECTOR:". 3. CSS breaker flex. 4. door-sense. 5. scan boolean. Let's implement. HTML clue label: ```

CREW PLAQUE // NAV-7

``` Footer: ``` PROJECTOR: ONLINE ``` Currently `PROJECTOR: ONLINE`. Edit. Game refs add clueLabel, projectorLabel; set in openConstellation. CSS fix. Door-sense: add helper: ``` function doorSenseActive(){ return Date.now() < state.doorSenseUntil } ``` In syncMarkers deck branches door attention includes `doorSenseActive()`. For deck0, deck1, deck2. After setting door-sense, `window.setTimeout(() => syncMarkers(), 30300)`. Scan boolean: modify: ``` function scan(enhanced=false) { if (!state.started || state.scanning) return false ... return true } ``` In useSkill deep-scan: ``` applied = scan(true) if (!applied) assistant.push('Scan already running...') ``` But if false, no toast? We can show warning and no spend. However scan() also shows assistant message. If returns false due scanning, show toast "SCAN BUSY". Let's set: ``` case deep-scan: { const started = scan(true) applied = started if (started) showToast... else assistant.push('Scan is already running. Give it a second.') break } ``` For hull-whisper same. Note scan() called by button ignores return. - Also `scan` starts `audio.scan`, room scanning. fine. Potential issue `scan(true)` and `state.scanning` false but state.started true. Good. Let's edit.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the existing ECHO-7 single-room escape game into a multi-deck ship escape where each room escape unlocks the next level, and PIP the co-pilot unlocks skills and earns gems for every completed task.
- The build request was to implement the change now, without clarifying questions.

## Requirements
- "different levels of the ship unlocks as u escape each room"
- "the co pilot unlocks skills and gems with every complete task"
- Must remain a complete, playable game.

## Decisions
- Implemented three sequential decks: `CRYO BAY`, `ENGINEERING`, `NAV BRIDGE`.
- Each deck has three tasks (9 total), each granting a gem reward and a unique PIP skill.
- Added 9 skills with active gem-cost abilities: Deep Scan, Overdrive, Surge, Hull Whisper, Star Sight, Door Sense, Vector Lock, Warp Core, Echo Legend.
- Reused the existing 3D room and added deck-specific lighting/theming, labels, props, markers, and custom engineering/bridge puzzle modals.
- Reused the existing star-sequence and keypad mechanics for both Cryo Bay and Nav Bridge with different sequences/codes.
- Engineering uses a new 3×3 Lights Out-style breaker grid keyed to `[0,4,7]`.
- Final launch replaces the original ending; ending now shows time, hints, gems, and skills.
- Assumed progression should persist within a run; no save/resume was added.

## Work State
### Completed
- Modified `index.html` with deck rail, dynamic deck/objective labels, PIP loadout/skill panel, breaker modal, deck-clear transition overlay, updated intro copy, and 4-stat ending.
- Rewrote `js/game.js` with multi-deck state, task rewards, gems, skills, deck transitions, engineering and bridge puzzles, dynamic objectives/markers/hints/scan/status, and final launch ending.
- Updated `js/scene.js` with deck themes, dynamic door labels, reset behavior, engineering reactor props, bridge nav-table props, and theme-driven lighting/animation.
- Appended CSS for deck accents, deck rail, PIP loadout, skill buttons, deck-clear screen, breaker modal, and responsive layouts.
- Verified full playthrough in Chromium via `playwright-cli`: all three decks, transitions, breaker puzzle, star alignments, keypads, skill use, and ending work.
- Verified result: ending showed `PIP 9/9`, `118` gems earned, rank `S`, no console errors (only WebGL performance warnings).
- Fixed bridge modal clue label to `DRIFT CHART // NAV-7` and footer to `ARRAY`.
- Fixed `.breaker-info .keypad-wide { flex: none; }` so RESET GRID no longer stretches.
- Added Door Sense marker attention and timeout refresh.
- Changed `scan()` to return boolean so skill charges are not wasted while a scan is active.

### Active
- Final regression check after fixes is in progress; the last automated playthrough reached Deck 03 with the constellation modal open and returned `label: "DRIFT CHART // NAV-7"`, `footer: "ARRAY"`, `deck: "DECK 03 // NAV BRIDGE"`, `modal: true`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Finish the current Deck 03 automated playthrough: solve stars in order `eye, castor, red, pollux`, enter keypad code `4826`, launch helm, and confirm the ending still appears with 9/9 skills.
2. Take a fresh screenshot of Deck 03 / ending after fixes if desired.
3. Test mobile layout with `playwright-cli resize 560 800` and confirm PIP loadout collapse and HUD fit.
4. Check `git diff`/`git status`; changes are currently uncommitted unless committed separately.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: Main game logic, decks, tasks, gems, skills, puzzles, transitions, ending.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/scene.js`: 3D scene, deck themes, props, dynamic labels, markers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: HUD, loadout panel, breaker modal, deck-clear overlay, ending markup.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: Deck accents, loadout, skill grid, deck-clear screen, breaker grid, responsive CSS.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/assistant.js`: PIP chat UI, unchanged.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: Audio engine, unchanged.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: Verification screenshots including `intro.png`, `game1.png`, `deck2.png`, `breaker.png`, `deck3.png`, `bridge-stars.png`, `ending.png`.

## Important Context
- Serve locally on port `3002` using `python3 -m http.server 3002` inside `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`; tmux session `echo7` is running it.
- `playwright-cli` browser had to be installed with `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`.
- Deck/code constants: Cryo sequence `red, castor, pollux, eye`, code `7394`; Bridge sequence `eye, castor, red, pollux`, code `4826`.
- Breaker puzzle initial state is generated by applying presses `[0,4,7]` to an all-on 3×3 grid; pressing the same cells solves it.
- Hidden markers can be triggered for test automation with DOM `.click()`, though real gameplay requires rotating the camera.
- No new files were created besides screenshots; changes remain in the working tree.

function completeTask(deckId, taskIndex, options = {}) {
  const deck = DECKS.find((entry) => entry.id === deckId)
  if (!deck) return null
  const flags = state.tasks[deckId]
  if (!flags || flags[taskIndex]) return null
  flags[taskIndex] = true
  const task = deck.tasks[taskIndex]
  const skill = SKILLS[task.skill]
  if (!state.skills.includes(task.skill)) state.skills.push(task.skill)
  state.gems += task.gem
  state.gemsEarned += task.gem
  refreshUi()
  if (!options.quiet) {
    setLoadoutOpen(true)
    showToast('TASK COMPLETE', task.title, `+${task.gem} gems  ·  ${skill.name} unlocked`, 'success')
    assistant.push(`Task complete: ${task.title}. I banked ${task.gem} gems and unlocked ${skill.name}. ${skill.desc}`, { tone: 'win' })
    audio.success()
  }
  return task
}

function enterDeck(index) {
  const deck = DECKS[index]
  if (!deck) return
  state.deckIndex = index
  state.transitioning = false
  state.sequence = []
  state.keypad = ''
  state.keypadLocked = false
  state.doorOpen = false
  state.hatchOpen = false
  if (index === 1) {
    state.cutterLockerOpen = false
    state.hasCutter = false
    state.breakerSolved = false
    state.breakerGrid = null
    state.breakerInitial = null

    state.navClueSeen = false

function renderBreaker() {
  const grid = state.breakerGrid || Array(9).fill(false)
  const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment()
  grid.forEach((lit, index) => {
    const cell = document.createElement('button')
    cell.type = 'button'
    cell.className = `breaker-cell${lit ? ' lit' : ''}`
    cell.dataset.cell = String(index)
    cell.setAttribute('aria-label', `Breaker cell ${index + 1}: ${lit ? 'online' : 'offline'}`)
    cell.textContent = lit ? 'ON' : 'OFF'
    cell.addEventListener('click', () => pressBreaker(index))
    fragment.appendChild(cell)
  })
  refs.breakerGrid.replaceChildren(fragment)
  const lit = grid.filter(Boolean).length
  refs.breakerMeter.style.width = `${(lit / 9) * 100}%`
}

function pressBreaker(index) {
  if (state.breakerSolved || !state.breakerGrid) return
  toggleBreakerCross(state.breakerGrid, index)
  audio.tone({ frequency: 240 + index * 35, duration: 0.06, type: 'square', volume: 0.03 })
  renderBreaker()
  if (state.breakerGrid.every(Boolean)) solveBreaker()
}

function setBreakerStatus(text, tone = '') {
  refs.breakerStatus.textContent = text
  refs.breakerStatus.className = `status-line${tone ? ` ${tone}` : ''}`
}

function solveBreaker() {
  if (state.breakerSolved) return
  state.breakerSolved = true
  state.breakerGrid = Array(9).fill(true)
  renderBreaker()
  setBreakerStatus('GRID STABLE', 'ok')
  refs.breakerFeed.textContent = 'STABLE'
  audio.success()
  completeTask('engineering', 1)
  assistant.push('Reactor feed stable. Hatch magnetic lock released. Take the plasma cutter to the deck hatch.', { tone: 'win' })
  showToast('REACTOR STABLE', 'Breaker grid online', 'The deck hatch magnetic lock is released.', 'success')
  window.setTimeout(() => closeModal(refs.breakerModal), 1600)
}

## Objective
- Extend the existing ECHO-7 escape game so the player can fly to Star V, dock, and explore freely.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing playable three-deck escape game and its PIP progression.
- Add a Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration flow.

## Decisions
- No design or implementation decisions have been made yet for Star V or free-roam exploration.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented and verified the existing three-deck escape game, task rewards, PIP skills, puzzles, transitions, and ending.
- Inspected the game UI, progression logic, and Three.js scene/input APIs for the planned extension.

### Active
- Plan and implement Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add a Star V destination and flight/docking flow after the existing launch.
2. Build a playable free-roam exploration mode.
3. Verify the new flow alongside the existing game and check responsive layouts.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, modals, and ending.
- `js/game.js`: Game progression, interactions, and event wiring.
- `js/scene.js`: Three.js room scene, hotspots, and camera input.
- `styles.css`: Game presentation and responsive layouts.

## Important Context

## Objective
- Extend the ECHO-7 escape game so the player can fly to Star V, dock, and explore freely.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing three-deck escape game and PIP progression.
- Add a Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration flow.

## Decisions
- No implementation or design decisions have been made for Star V.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing three-deck escape game and PIP progression were previously implemented and verified.
- Inspected the game flow and Three.js scene/input code for the planned extension.

### Active
- Plan and implement Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add a Star V flight and docking sequence after the bridge launch.
2. Build playable free-roam exploration on Star V.
3. Verify the new flow alongside the existing game and check responsive layouts.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, modals, and ending.
- `js/game.js`: Game progression, interactions, and `finishGame()`.
- `js/scene.js`: Three.js scene, hotspots, and camera input.
- `styles.css`: Game presentation and responsive layouts.

## Important Context
- The latest `git status --short` output was empty.
- `finishGame()` currently ends the game after launching ECHO-7; no Star V flow is implemented.
- Existing code supports looking around and interacting with hotspot markers, but no free-roam movement.

## Objective
- Extend the ECHO-7 escape game so the player can fly to Star V, dock, and explore freely.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing three-deck escape game and PIP progression.
- Add a Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration flow.

## Decisions
- No Star V design or implementation decisions have been made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing three-deck escape game and PIP progression were previously implemented and verified.
- Inspected game flow and Three.js scene/input code for the planned extension.

### Active
- Plan and implement Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add Star V flight and docking after the bridge launch.
2. Build playable free-roam exploration on Star V.
3. Verify the new flow alongside the existing game and check responsive layouts.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, modals, and ending.
- `js/game.js`: Game progression, interactions, and `finishGame()`.
- `js/scene.js`: Three.js scene, hotspots, and camera input.
- `styles.css`: Game presentation and responsive layouts.

## Important Context
- `finishGame()` currently ends the game after launching ECHO-7; no Star V flow is implemented.
- Existing code supports looking around and interacting with hotspot markers, but no free-roam movement.
- The latest recorded `git status --short` output was empty.

## Objective
- Extend the ECHO-7 escape game so the player can fly to Star V, dock, and explore freely.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing three-deck escape game and PIP progression.
- Add a Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration flow.

## Decisions
- No Star V design or implementation decisions have been made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing three-deck escape game and PIP progression were previously implemented and verified.
- Inspected game flow, Three.js scene/input code, and UI styles for the planned extension.

### Active
- Plan and implement Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add Star V flight and docking after the bridge launch.
2. Build playable free-roam exploration on Star V.
3. Verify the new flow alongside the existing game and check responsive layouts.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Game progression, interactions, and `finishGame()`.
- `js/scene.js`: Three.js scene, hotspots, and camera input.
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, modals, and ending.
- `styles.css`: Game presentation and responsive layouts.

## Important Context
- `finishGame()` currently ends the game after launching ECHO-7; no Star V flow is implemented.
- Existing code supports looking around and interacting with hotspot markers, but no free-roam movement.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Extend the ECHO-7 escape game so the player can fly to Star V, dock, and explore freely.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing three-deck escape game and PIP progression.
- Add a Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration flow.

## Decisions
- No Star V design or implementation decisions have been made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing three-deck escape game and PIP progression were previously implemented and verified.
- Inspected game flow, Three.js scene/input code, and UI styles for the planned extension.

### Active
- Plan and implement Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add Star V flight and docking after the bridge launch.
2. Build playable free-roam exploration on Star V.
3. Verify the new flow alongside the existing game and check responsive layouts.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Game progression, interactions, and `finishGame()`.
- `js/scene.js`: Three.js scene, hotspots, and camera input.
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, modals, and ending.
- `styles.css`: Game presentation and responsive layouts.

## Important Context
- `finishGame()` currently ends the game after launching ECHO-7; no Star V flow is implemented.
- Existing code supports looking around and interacting with hotspot markers, but no free-roam movement.
- Recent inspection did not make code changes.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Extend the ECHO-7 escape game so the player can fly to Star V, dock, and explore freely.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing three-deck escape game and PIP progression.
- Add a Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration flow.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game flow, Three.js scene/input code, and UI relevant to extending the game.

### Active
- Plan and implement Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add Star V flight and docking after the bridge launch.
2. Build playable free-roam exploration on Star V.
3. Verify the new flow alongside the existing game and check responsive layouts.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Game progression, interactions, and `finishGame()`.
- `js/scene.js`: Three.js scene, hotspots, camera input, and deck setup.
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, modals, and ending.
- `styles.css`: Game presentation and responsive layouts.

## Important Context
- No code changes have been made during the latest inspection.
- `finishGame()` currently ends the game after launching ECHO-7; no Star V flow is implemented.
- Existing code supports looking around and interacting with hotspot markers, but not free-roam movement.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Extend the ECHO-7 escape game so the player can fly to Star V, dock, and explore freely.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing three-deck escape game and PIP progression.
- Add a Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration flow.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game progression, Three.js scene/input code, and relevant UI.

### Active
- Plan and implement Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add a Star V flight and docking sequence after the bridge launch.
2. Build playable free-roam exploration on Star V.
3. Verify the new flow alongside the existing game and check responsive layouts.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Game progression, interactions, and current `finishGame()` ending.
- `js/scene.js`: Three.js scene construction, hotspots, camera input, and rendering.
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, modals, and current ending screen.
- `styles.css`: Game presentation and responsive layouts.

## Important Context
- No code changes have been made.
- `finishGame()` currently ends the game after the ECHO-7 launch; no Star V flow or free-roam movement exists.
- `EchoRoom` uses a fixed scene and camera-positioned markers; pointer drag and arrow keys currently control looking around.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Extend the ECHO-7 escape game so the player can fly to Star V, dock, and explore freely.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing three-deck escape game and PIP progression.
- Add a Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration flow.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected game progression, Three.js scene/input code, and relevant UI; no code changes made.

### Active
- Plan and implement Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add a Star V flight and docking sequence after the bridge launch.
2. Build playable free-roam exploration on Star V.
3. Verify the new flow alongside the existing game and check responsive layouts.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Game progression, interactions, and current `finishGame()` ending.
- `js/scene.js`: Three.js scene construction, hotspots, camera input, and rendering.
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, modals, and current ending screen.
- `styles.css`: Game presentation and responsive layouts.

## Important Context
- `finishGame()` currently ends the game after the ECHO-7 launch; no Star V flow or free-roam movement exists.
- `EchoRoom` builds a fixed room; pointer drag and arrow keys control looking around, not movement.
- No code changes have been made.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Extend the ECHO-7 escape game so the player can fly to Star V, dock, and explore freely.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing three-deck escape game and PIP progression.
- Add a Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration flow.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected game progression, Three.js scene/input code, and relevant UI; no code changes made.

### Active
- Plan and implement Star V flight, docking, and free-roam exploration.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add a Star V flight and docking sequence after the bridge launch.
2. Build playable free-roam exploration on Star V.
3. Verify the new flow alongside the existing game and check responsive layouts.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Game progression, interactions, and current `finishGame()` ending.
- `js/scene.js`: Three.js scene construction, hotspots, camera input, and rendering.
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, modals, and current ending screen.
- `styles.css`: Game presentation and responsive layouts.

## Important Context
- `finishGame()` currently ends the game after the ECHO-7 launch; no Star V flow or free-roam movement exists.
- `EchoRoom` builds a fixed room; pointer drag and arrow keys control looking around, not movement.

Do not edit; report exact relevant functions and safe extension approach.
